# payload-dumper-go

Earlier RedMagicEMU builds bundled the `linux_arm64` release as `lib/arm64-v8a/libpayloaddumper.so`. The binary was removed in `212a04a`. [payload-dumper-go 2.1.0](https://github.com/ssut/payload-dumper-go)

The release archive had SHA-256 `5743a39b48d0c4dab948ad6e5d9ff275e649528e5dfd2b7db4b6893093b70f6c`. [License](LICENSE)
